item.title: New Initiative Gifts Birthday Cakes To Kids In Shelters
item.description: Justin turned five last Sunday. His mother Alysha wished him a happy birthday when he got up and gave him a hug. That was that. Until that evening, when he encountered a group of people in the kitchen of Life Haven -- and a thickly frosted cake on the table.
